label: City share of taxable sales
description: City share of taxable sales (Bradley-Burns local 1%)
source: CA Rev. & Tax. Code 7202 (Bradley-Burns 1% local rate)

label: Measure Q local sales tax
description: Ontario Measure Q transactions and use tax on sales made or delivered in the city (added to Bradley-Burns for in-person spending)
source: City of Ontario FY 2026-27 Adopted Annual Operating Budget PDF p. 14 and p. 64 (Measure Q: 1% transactions and use tax effective April 1 2023; destination-based)

label: Pathway hire wage
description: Annual wage of a converted pathway hire (overridden by OEWS medians when loaded)
source: Proposal Sec. 3 quoted regional medians; replaced by BLS OEWS MSA medians when available

label: Income spent on taxable goods
description: Share of a worker's income spent on taxable goods
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey (West region)

label: Resident spending kept in Ontario
description: Share of a resident's taxable spending made inside Ontario
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from CDTFA/retail leakage study

label: Interns per year at full scale
description: Paid interns/apprentices per year at full scale (10-20 employers)
source: Proposal Sec. 5 Phase 1 (10-20 employers); interns per employer is a team assumption

label: Interns hired full-time
description: Share of interns converted to a full-time job in Ontario
source: NACE Internship & Co-op Survey: conversion 46% (hybrid) and 58.5% (in-person) for 2023-24 interns; 63.1% for 2024-25. National employer sample; local and smaller employers likely lower

label: Pathway hires who live in Ontario
description: Share of converted hires who live in Ontario
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - program recruits Ontario residents first

label: Pathway hires that are truly extra
description: Share of hires that would NOT have happened without the program
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - removes deadweight (hires that happen anyway)

label: Placed workers who leave each year
description: Annual share of program-placed local workers who leave the job or city
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from BLS JOLTS separations rate

label: Annual growth in venue visits
description: Annual real growth of anchor-venue visits (status quo)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - replace with ONT traffic trend once data/ont_airport_passengers.csv is filled

label: Venue visits that are unique trips
description: Share of anchor visits that are unique trips (visitors attend several anchors)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - Stay +1 data collection (Phase 1) measures cross-visitation

label: Stay +1 uptake (share of overnight parties)
description: Share of overnight visitor parties that add one night through Stay +1
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - package uptake; measured in Phase 1

label: Visitors per room-night
description: Visitors per room-night (also party size)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - sports/event families skew higher

label: Average daily room rate
description: Average daily room rate (real FY2025 dollars); replaced at run time by the rate implied by hotel tax and rooms and occupancy
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - fallback only; the run derives it from official hotel tax and room supply (see hotel_rooms and hotel_occupancy)

label: Hotel rooms in Ontario
description: Hotel and motel rooms in the City (52 properties)
source: City of Ontario FY 2026-27 Adopted Annual Operating Budget PDF p. 66

label: Hotel occupancy
description: Average share of hotel rooms sold per night (sets the room rate implied by hotel tax)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from STR or Greater Ontario CVB

label: Hotel tax (TOT) rate
description: Ontario Transient Occupancy Tax rate
source: City of Ontario FY 2026-27 Adopted Annual Operating Budget PDF p. 66 (Ontario Municipal Code 3-6.03: 11.75% of rent)

label: Visitor spending per extra day
description: Non-lodging taxable spend per visitor per added day (real $)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from Visit California / Dean Runyan county visitor spending

label: Stay +1 nights that are truly extra
description: Share of added nights that would NOT have happened without Stay +1
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - removes visitors who would have extended anyway

label: Downtown share of citywide sales
description: Downtown pilot district share of citywide taxable sales
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from CDTFA/HdL district sales data

source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from BID ambassador program evaluations

label: Downtown uplift not shifted from elsewhere
description: Share of district uplift not displaced from elsewhere in Ontario
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - some spending shifts from other Ontario districts

label: Firms attracted or retained per year
description: Firms attracted or retained per year via workforce + international pipeline
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - illustrative; track via business attraction pipeline

label: Jobs per attracted firm
description: Jobs per attracted/retained firm
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from QCEW establishment size for target sectors

label: Firm jobs filled by residents
description: Share of those jobs filled by Ontario residents
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - LODES baseline share of jobs held by residents is a floor

label: Firm decisions due to the program
description: Share of firm decisions attributable to the program
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - most location decisions have many causes

label: Business taxable sales per attracted job
description: Taxable sales allocated to Ontario per job at attracted firms (real $)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - point-of-sale logistics/distribution firms can be far higher

label: Program cost / yr: Career Pathways (R1)
description: Program cost per year: Career Pathways coordination (staffing and project management)
source: Proposal draft budget table: staffing/project management $75K-$150K/yr. Full program cost (City + partners): the draft does not state the City's share. Mode is the range midpoint and is used only in gated simulations; reported results use the low and high

label: Program cost / yr: R2 marketing and packages
description: Program cost per year: Stay +1 packages + Ontario Pass + evening programming + visitor marketing
source: Proposal draft budget table: technology/data/marketing/outreach $100K-$250K/yr. Full program cost (City + partners): the draft does not state the City's share. Mode is the range midpoint and is used only in gated simulations; reported results use the low and high

label: Program cost / yr: R2 evening circulator
description: Program cost per year: two-bus evening circulator pilot (1248 vehicle-hours at the Omnitrans rate)
source: Proposal draft; rate verified: Omnitrans Service Plan FY2026 Exhibit 10 PDF p. 13: $95,293K operating cost / 620K revenue hours = $153.70 per revenue hour (calculated). Full program cost (City + partners): the draft does not state the City's share. Mode is the range midpoint and is used only in gated simulations; reported results use the low and high. The City's $120K Internal Circulator Planning Study due Dec 2026 (City of Ontario FY 2026-27 Adopted Annual Operating Budget PDF pp. 408, 487) should confirm cost and funding

label: Program cost / yr: Downtown ambassadors (R3)
description: Program cost per year: Downtown ambassador pilot
source: Proposal draft: $350K-$550K/yr for a small supervised pilot. Full program cost (City + partners): the draft does not state the City's share. Mode is the range midpoint and is used only in gated simulations; reported results use the low and high

label: City cost / yr: employer partnerships (R4)
description: City cost per year: international/employer partnerships (Phase 3-4)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - not budgeted in the proposal yet

label: Placed workers who are new residents

source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - track via participant address at hire and at 1/3/5 years

label: People per new household
description: Residents per household formed by a retained/new resident worker
source: U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts: Ontario city 3.37 persons per household (ACS 2019-2023); range allows new households to differ

label: City property tax per household
description: City General Fund property tax per household (real $/yr)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - VERIFY from City budget property tax / housing units (Ontario Ranch new homes skew higher)

label: Spending per other household member
description: Taxable spending in Ontario per additional household member who is not the worker (real $/yr)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - source from BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey

label: Firms attracted per 100 pathway workers
description: Added firms/yr per 100 Career Pathways placements in the local workforce stock (workforce pipeline as an attraction tool)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - the proposal's core claim; test via business attraction pipeline tracking

label: New local spending by staying residents
description: Share of a placed worker's local taxable spending that is new when the worker would have lived in Ontario anyway (higher wage; spending near a local job)
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - counterfactual: these residents already spent in Ontario; source from wage gain at placement

label: Real discount rate
description: Real annual discount rate for present-value return on investment
source: TEAM ASSUMPTION - OMB Circular A-4 uses 2% (2023) and 3% (2003) real; confirm the rate City Finance uses
